ASDP.STAT_NO = #PAY_AREA_CD:VARCHAR#
SELECT T.TYPE_ID, T.TYPE_NAME FROM PA_CALCULATE_TYPE T WHERE T.ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY T.ORDERNO

SELECT DISTINCT ASDP.STAT_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(ASDP.STAT_NO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) STAT_NAME FROM AR_STATISTIC_DATE_PARAM ASDP,AR_STATISTIC_EMPTYPE ASE, AR_SUPERVISOR_EMPTYPE_INFO SSEI WHERE ASDP.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND ASE.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND ASDP.STAT_NO = ASE.STAT_NO AND ASE.EMP_TYPE_CODE = SSEI.EMP_TYPE_CODE AND SSEI.PERSON_ID = #supervisorPersonId:VARCHAR#

SELECT DISTINCT GET_DEPT_NAME(HD.DEPTNO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPTNAME, HD.DEPTNO,hd.orderno FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HD WHERE HD.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND HD.DEPT_LEVEL = '2' START WITH HD.DEPTNO IN (SELECT DISTINCT T.DEPTNO FROM PA_SUPERVISOR_INFO T WHERE T.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# ) CONNECT BY PRIOR HD.PARENT_DEPT_NO = HD.DEPTNO order siblings by orderno

SELECT DISTINCT GET_DEPT_NAME(HD.DEPTNO, #interLanguage:VARCHAR#) DEPTNAME, HD.DEPTNO,hd.orderno FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HD WHERE HD.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND HD.DEPT_LEVEL = '2' START WITH HD.DEPTNO IN (SELECT DISTINCT T.DEPTNO FROM SY_USER_DEPT T WHERE T.USER_NO = ( SELECT SU.USER_NO FROM SY_USER SU WHERE SU.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# ) ) CONNECT BY PRIOR HD.PARENT_DEPT_NO = HD.DEPTNO order siblings by orderno

SELECT PA_SUPERVISOR.PERSON_ID SUPERVISOR_ID, HR_EMPLOYEE.EMPID, HR_EMPLOYEE.LOCAL_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.CONTENT DEPTNAME, TO_CHAR(PA_SUPERVISOR.CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') CREATE_DATE, HE.LOCAL_NAME CREATED_BY FROM PA_SUPERVISOR, HR_EMPLOYEE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_EMPLOYEE HE WHERE PA_SUPERVISOR.PERSON_ID = HR_EMPLOYEE.PERSON_ID AND HR_EMPLOYEE.DEPTNO = HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.DEPTNO(+) AND HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND PA_SUPERVISOR.CREATED_BY = HE.PERSON_ID(+) AND HR_EMPLOYEE.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#
(EXISTS( SELECT * FROM PA_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE PA_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = HR_EMPLOYEE.DEPTNO AND PA_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #PA_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR# ) OR HR_EMPLOYEE.PERSON_ID = #PA_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR#)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PA_BONUS_HISTORY T WHERE T.PA_MONTH = #PA_MONTH:VARCHAR# AND T.PA_CALCULATE_TYPE_ID = #PA_CALCULATE_TYPE:VARCHAR#

SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(T.GIVE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') PACAL_GIVE_DATE FROM PA_CALC_OBJECT T WHERE T.PA_MONTH =#paMonth:VARCHAR# AND T.CPNY_ID =#CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
